name: Potentiometer
summary: A potentiometer uses a movable contact on a resistive element to provide a documented adjustable divider or resistance.
description: A potentiometer uses a movable contact on a resistive element to provide a documented adjustable divider or resistance. Its end terminals and wiper must be distinguishable.
readingNotes: Trace the wiper separately from the two fixed ends.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A potentiometer used as a divider has three circuit connections; a rheostat connection uses a variable resistive path.
